summary: Official Prefeitura de Anápolis sources establish a local municipal cadastral/map custodian and identify the Geomais portal plus mapoteca and cadastral-sheet services. No anonymous parcel ID plus geometry response was verified; no GeoJSON sample was retained. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
queryOutcomes: English and Brazilian Portuguese discovery queries are recorded in city-5305-an-polis.json. Results were limited to official municipal Geomais, mapoteca/planning, citizen portal and cadastral-sheet pages.
requestOutcomes: Geomais direct GET timed out after 20 seconds; the indexed landing page is JavaScript-only with login/access controls. Official mapoteca, cadastral-sheet and citizen-portal pages were reviewed as first-party HTML evidence; cadastral-sheet services require login. No credentials, private tokens or unsafe property fields were used.
scopeLimits: Local municipal custody is evidenced, but no city boundary or complete Anápolis parcel coverage was established.
No exact-point hit/miss was used as an absence claim; the WUP point remains [-16.3250430006323, -48.9520198956505].
No parcel geometry, native parcel ID, schema or CRS was retrieved, so no sample GeoJSON was retained.
General/national agency prose was not used to claim a local open registry; only Prefeitura de Anápolis sources support registryFound=true.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond a safe native parcel ID
credentials, private tokens and personal data
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. If a future public response is found, retain only one stable native identity in GeoJSON properties and document source field mapping here.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No parcel geometry query reached a usable public service. The exact WUP point was preserved but no hit/miss inference was made.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Municipal custody and described services verified; open parcel geometry not verified.

serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: The current viewer/API endpoint, anonymous access behavior, layer schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity and exact-point coverage remain unknown. Direct timeout and login wall are recorded as access limitations, not absence claims.
